readings.Aries: You function best when there is something to push against. Right now, push gently. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Taurus: There's something quietly growing in a direction you haven't examined lately. Look now. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Gemini: You process everything through language. Today, there is something language can't quite reach. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Cancer: The shell is not the whole organism. Let someone see the rest. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Leo: You radiate energy that others orient toward. Use this for good today — including your own good. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Virgo: The standard you hold for your work is a form of love. Make sure it's not the only form you're using. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Libra: You are most fully yourself when you are in good company. Today you need your own company. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Scorpio: You do not give second chances easily. In this case, one more data point might be warranted. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Sagittarius: The adventure you need does not require travel. Change the frame of what's in front of you. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Capricorn: Something you've built together with someone else is worth tending to. Not as a project. As a relationship. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Aquarius: Someone is trying to reach you through the systems you've put up. Let them. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Pisces: You've been trying to make sense of something that can only be felt, not understood. Feel it. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
